method: 10 random tariff_lines pulled with their parent titles; fts_search_text compared against re-computed CONCAT_WS(' ', chapter.title, heading.title, subheading.title, description).

results.detail: When subheading.title='' (empty string, 454 such rows total), the trigger produces a double-space artifact (e.g. 'kinds.  Personal' instead of 'kinds. Personal'). Functional impact: ZERO — to_tsvector('english', ...) treats any whitespace run as a token boundary. This is cosmetic only; FTS matching, tokenization, and ranking are unaffected.

follow_up_recommendation: Optional: tighten the refresh_fts_search_text trigger to use NULLIF(BTRIM(...), '') for each title segment. Not blocking — FTS works correctly today.
